# Lua graph observer cost candidate

Base: `67793786f82db4059e9de463674bd40e4be38932`; local branch `feat/graph-observer-cost`.

Only implementation/test files changed by this worker:
- `tests/helpers/lua-graph-observer.mjs` SHA256 `a93fb46a50b261dea20156bd1d0c2dfdfe06c912b13966ccb9568e6fe9229b3f`
- `tests/game-ui-host-result.test.mjs` SHA256 `1925f0e8fb4558f95e19fdc1c8dcd4371dd85f24f63db26e97a8d3aa0c24dd71`

Changes remove primitive capture wrappers, repeat key decoding, repeated fixed type-name conversion/pointer lookups, and JSON encoding of unchanged definitions. Every reachable table field and metatable is freshly traversed. Previous definition arrays are comparison-only. Snapshot-local proxy lifetime, ID allocation/sort order, all graph fields and all checkpoints remain. No Lua string byte cache retained.

## Independent original/candidate parity

`original-observer.mjs` was saved before the first edit. Its SHA256 `ddef991a2c414dcf6838cc9d343fa99269ae9d9c297368b3ac8df46cd785fa15` matches `git show 67793786:tests/helpers/lua-graph-observer.mjs`.

- Complete original frozen391 parasite_08 stream: 678 checkpoints, 5,231,138 bytes, SHA256 `48a75ed8ad3ce2ac0ecf010b7b92821d38e02bc36ebffed4c787a519f1bfaac9`.
- Candidate produces the exact same stream; binary `cmp` and Buffer equality pass, not merely matching checkpoint counts.
- `adversarial-parity.mjs` runs separate original/candidate VMs in return-string and WRITE modes. All four full streams: 11,962 bytes, SHA256 `0e838aea2f09440f61e7fdf07d3c026a6a48aa42c14c4595d6719576f4d5917e`.
- Adversarial fixture covers stable/nonstable interleaving, event varargs/packed args, nil arity, Unicode/NUL, mutable Uint8Array value bytes and restoration, false/true/numeric/table/function/C-function/userdata/thread keys, cycles, aliases, same-value alias replacement/merge, isolated value/key/metatable mutations, detach/return, control backing and engine state changes, function/userdata/thread metatables.
- Added permanent fixed-original-stream digest test plus invalid UTF-8 after in-place buffer mutation. Existing tests and fixtures unchanged.
- `negative-controls.json`: ignoring entry values, entry keys, metatable references, or typed-pair payloads is rejected (all four KILLED).

## Bounded timings and memory

All lifecycle subprocesses retained timeout=30,000ms and maxBuffer=1MiB.

Initial unchanged observer: 27,886ms; final candidate: 24,226ms (13.1% lower).
Sequential repeat with resource recording: original 29,172ms; candidate 24,979ms (14.4% lower).
`repeat-measurements.json` holds full original/candidate manifests, stdout, process resource counters, memory samples. Repeated trace bytes are identical.

Observed maxRSS: original 1,072,944KiB; candidate 905,616KiB. This is one measured peak comparison, not a retained-heap guarantee. End-of-process heapUsed was 546,275,064B original versus 723,726,728B candidate; GC timing was not normalized. heapTotal was 839,094,272B versus 798,318,592B.

Rejected experiment: byte-verified WeakMap decoding reuse was slower (28,222ms) and was removed. Structural comparison alone was 27,193ms; removal of capture wrappers/key re-decoding gave 26,054ms. Final avoids redundant type labels/pointer lookup too. A CPU profile of parasite_01 identified traversal, GC, proxy creation and conversion costs; a profile of parasite_08 hit the unchanged 30s limit and produced no usable final profile. This diagnostic failure is not counted as a passing test.

## Final verification

- `node --check` for both changed modules: pass.
- `git diff --check`: pass.
- Six graph-specific `game-ui-host-result.test.mjs` tests: pass.
- Existing `full graph observer rejects alias split/merge, RNG limb and return arity changes` strength test: pass.
- Original unmodified `relic lifecycle parasite_08 full frozen-source VM matches current complete graph` Node test: pass in 50,858ms total. Its child VMs were frozen391 24,943ms and current 25,728ms, each below its unchanged 30s cap. All original graph/manifest/source/case/checkpoint/assertion comparisons execute. See `parasite08-node-test.log` and `../relic-lifecycle/parasite_08-{frozen391,current}/`.

No Full, full host windows, complete lifecycle suite, official runtime/device test, push, commit or PR publication performed. No timeout/assertion/fixture-source reductions. Coordinator-owned TASK-100 dirty file was left untouched.
